1910.s: "I never saw a prettier hat, but I like best the head as bobs under it."
Anne's tone seemed to say that she could not imagine a prettier hat, and she shook her head.
It was really a much prettier hat than theirs, but they spoke about it unkindly, and laughed at Caroline.

1920.s: “Of course, ” he said, “your hats are ever so much prettier than hers.”
